verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Financial Connections instantly verifies bank accounts for ACH Direct Debit. They describe an 'instant' verification mode with no manual entry and no microdeposit fallback, which keeps users from having to look up account and routing numbers. A beta customer independently confirms using it for instant account verification on ACH payments after moving from Plaid Auth. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the verified account/routing numbers or tokenized payment method are returned to the developer, and detail on bank coverage and success rates for instant verification.
